goal: Five Quiet Precision family concepts, each visibly preserving project tabs created by expanding cards, grounded in actual tab behavior.
hypothesis: Inspecting expand/tab/restore behavior and showing identical tab-enabled states in five restrained variations prevents losing the existing navigation.
scope: Design artifacts and isolated app fixtures only; no product implementation, live user data changes or publication.

checks.description: Actual isolated app expand/tab/restore behavior inspected and captured. Fails if behavior is invented or only generic tabs assumed.
Original product source, live .workspace and previous design outputs unchanged.

Exactly five new visuals: updated Quiet Precision and four related variants. Every visual visibly includes existing Board/Table views plus at least two identifiable project tabs; selected project full-screen state consistent across all, with Properties and File tree and restore/close access. Fails if tabs merely mentioned in prose or confused with views.

All five preserve first concept light neutral/lavender/sidebar identity and same project/data/state, while providing distinct refinements in tab treatment, hierarchy, density or panel composition, with Russian explanation and recommendation.
Local gallery and all five PNGs load; report explains Board → details → expand/tab → restore and exact access mapping. Previous outputs retained.

supersedes_reason: User selected Quiet Precision and requested updated original plus four related variations with full-screen project tabs
